calls.title: Growthbook <> Simpli.fi - Demo
calls.summary: GrowthBook demonstrated its feature flagging and experimentation platform to Simpli.fi's marketing and engineering team, focusing on low-code A/B testing for website optimization and addressing pain points around limited engineering resources and integration with HubSpot data. Key participants included GrowthBook's Daniel Wathne (sales) and Logan Bates (solutions engineer), along with Simpli.fi's Koy Eddleman, Carson Rogers, Corbyn Cunningham, Ben Lobaugh, and Alexander Vyhmeister.
